item.filasignal.data_drive.hint: Use on a computer to program, or on a device to install
block.filasignal.programmable_computer.t: Runs your FilaScript programs and controls devices on its network.
block.filasignal.programmable_computer.h: Right-click to open. Link devices to it through a Network Repeater.
block.filasignal.network_repeater.toolti: Relays network links between a computer and its devices.
block.filasignal.network_repeater.hint: Link the computer to it, then link devices to it (32 blocks).
block.filasignal.network_interface.toolt: Older relay with redstone ports and inventory faces.
block.filasignal.network_interface.hint: Still works. New builds can use a repeater, controller and module.
block.filasignal.sensor.tooltip: Older player sensor for sensor.detected events.
block.filasignal.sensor.hint: Still works. New builds can use an Entity Detector.
block.filasignal.entity_detector.tooltip: Sees players, mobs and items nearby.
block.filasignal.weather_station.tooltip: Reads the weather and the time of day.
block.filasignal.weather_station.hint: Programs react with on sky.rainStart or sky.nightStart.
block.filasignal.redstone_controller.too: Reads and sends redstone on all six sides.
block.filasignal.redstone_controller.hin: Choose input or output for each side in its form.
block.filasignal.inventory_module.toolti: Reads and moves items in chests next to it.
block.filasignal.inventory_module.hint: The owner approves each chest face in its form.
block.filasignal.environment_sensor.tool: Measures light, sky and biome above it.
block.filasignal.environment_sensor.hint: Programs react when it gets dark or bright.
block.filasignal.display_module.tooltip: Shows up to 8 lines of text on its screen.
block.filasignal.alarm_module.tooltip: Plays a warning sound and glows.
block.filasignal.storage_server.tooltip: Shared storage for every program on its network.
block.filasignal.storage_server.hint: Breaking it deletes everything stored in it.
block.filasignal.access_controller.toolt: Opens a door for allowed players, no program needed.
block.filasignal.access_controller.hint: Sneak-use to set who may enter. Use it to ask to enter.
block.filasignal.control_panel.tooltip: Four buttons that programs react to.
block.filasignal.control_panel.hint: Use it to press. Rename buttons in its form.
block.filasignal.wireless_bridge.tooltip: Joins two parts of a network up to 256 blocks apart.
block.filasignal.wireless_bridge.hint: Pair two bridges you own from the form.
item.filasignal.linking_tool.tooltip: Connects a computer, repeaters and devices.
item.filasignal.linking_tool.hint: Click one block, then the other. Sneak-click the second block to unlink.
filasignal.help.tooltip: Open the FilaSignal guide for this in your browser
filasignal.storage.warning: This Storage Server holds %s stored keys. Breaking it deletes them.
